color-surface.$description: A card, a panel, a field: what sits on the canvas.

color-sunken.$description: A well in a surface: a search field, a track.

color-raised.$description: A dialog, a menu: what floats above.

color-hover.$description: A secondary control under the pointer.

color-tint.$description: The accent's ground: a chosen card, an information banner.

color-divider.$description: A line that divides, and only that.

color-edge.$description: A control's edge, 3:1 on each ground.

color-text-soft.$description: Secondary words: a hint, a date, a detail.

color-text-faint.$description: Tertiary words, on any ground at 4.5:1.

color-accent.$description: Links, focus, the primary action; « Vous ».

color-accent-hover.$description: The primary action under the pointer.

color-success.$description: Ready, sent, saved: success alone, never a voice.

color-record.$description: A recording: its live dot. Red says a recording or a deletion, nothing else.

color-destructive.$description: A deletion's button, always confirmed, « Annuler » focused.

color-private.$description: « Confidentielle », with the lock: its pill, its banner. Nowhere else.

color-voice-you.$description: « Vous »: the microphone, in the waveform, the meters, the transcript.

color-voice-others.$description: « Les autres »: the call's sound; teal in light, golden amber in dark.
